name: pen-desktop
steps: bin=$1 log=$2; rm -f "$log"; i=0; until [ -S "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/$WAYLAND_DISPLAY" ]; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -le 60 ] || { echo "no $WAYLAND_DISPLAY in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; setsid -f stdbuf -oL "$bin" >"$log" 2>&1 </dev/null; i=0; until grep -q xdg_surface "$log" 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -le 40 ] || { echo "wev opened no window:" >&2; tail -n 5 "$log" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 0.5; done; sleep 1

bin=$1 log=$2; rm -f "$log"; i=0; until x=$(pgrep -a Xwayland | grep -e ' -wm ' | head -n 1) && [ -n "$x" ]; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -le 60 ] || { echo "KWin runs no Xwayland" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done; unset DISPLAY XAUTHORITY; set -- $x; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case $1 in :[0-9]*) export DISPLAY=$1 ;; -auth) export XAUTHORITY=$2 ;; esac; shift; done; setsid -f stdbuf -oL "$bin" test-xi2 >"$log" 2>&1 </dev/null; i=0; until grep -q 'Virtual core pointer' "$log" 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -le 40 ] || { echo "xinput test-xi2 did not start:" >&2; tail -n 5 "$log" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 0.5; done; sleep 2

import collections, json, re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1], errors='replace').read()
tools = {d: t for t, d in re.findall(r'xwayland-tablet (\w+)\S*\s+id=(\d+)', text)}
axis = dict.fromkeys(tools, '2')
axis.update(re.findall(r'originated from: (\d+)\. Type: XIValuatorClass\s+Detail for Valuator (\d+):\s+Label: Abs Pressure', text))
events, motion, presses, pressure = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter(), collections.Counter(), 0.0
for block in text.split('EVENT type ')[1:]:
    kind = re.match(r'\d+ \((\w+)\)', block)
    source = re.search(r'device: \d+ \((\d+)\)', block)
    events[kind and kind.group(1)] += 1
    if not kind or not source or source.group(1) not in axis:
        continue
    device = source.group(1)
    tool = tools.get(device, device)
    if kind.group(1) == 'Motion':
        motion[tool] += 1
        values = dict(re.findall(r'^[ \t]+(\d+): (-?[\d.]+)[ \t]*$', block, re.M))
        pressure = max(pressure, float(values.get(axis[device], 0)))
    elif kind.group(1) == 'ButtonPress':
        presses['%s:%s' % (tool, re.search(r'detail: (\d+)', block).group(1))] += 1
print(json.dumps({'events': events, 'tablets': tools, 'motion': motion, 'buttonPress': presses, 'maxPressure': pressure}))
checks = [('motion', sum(motion.values())), ('pressure', pressure), ('button_press', sum(n for k, n in presses.items() if k.endswith(':1')))]
print(' '.join('[x11:%s]' % c for c, n in checks if n))
